protocol: 2026-09-26, RTX 4090 laptop (quiet machine not asserted; relative numbers only): one ISLA geometry region (routing bias + point->slice softmax + pooled invariants) at B=1, N=20,000 points, S=256 slices, K=1, bf16 autocast, forward + backward, mean of 10 steps after 3 warm-ups; peak allocated memory of the region alone.
note: the MLP branch is arithmetic-bound (16 hidden units x erf per pair); the linear kernel is memory-bound. Optimization candidates: hoist the per-unit weight loads, tanh-free erf, larger BLOCK_N for the MLP branch.

protocol_scale.note: AGA GB300 node (4 GPUs, DDP), whole training epoch wall time from the train.log timestamps, epochs 5-40, single seed 42 lanes; AirfRANS 800 airfoils x 100,000 queries; DrivAerML Surface 435 cars x 200,000 cells. Fused-linear comparators are the frame lanes (K = 3 / K = 4) of campaign fa, not K = 1 lanes, so the linear ratio is an upper bound on the MLP's price against K = 1.
